name: Single-cell RNA-seq
overview: 10x Genomics 单细胞转录组标准分析流程，涵盖数据预处理、降维聚类、差异分析和细胞类型注释。

steps.name: 数据预处理
steps.description: Cell Ranger 生成表达矩阵 + 过滤低质量细胞
steps.notes: 10x 下机数据通过 Cell Ranger mkfastq + count 生成表达矩阵。过滤标准：nFeature_RNA > 200 & < 6000, percent.mt < 20%。
steps.descriptionEn: Cell Ranger expression matrix + low-quality cell filtering
steps.notesEn: 10x data processed by Cell Ranger mkfastq + count. Filter: nFeature_RNA > 200 & < 6000, percent.mt < 20%.

steps.name: 归一化 + 高变基因
steps.notes: SCTransform 优于传统 LogNormalize，能更好地校正测序深度差异。回归掉线粒体基因比例。
steps.notesEn: SCTransform outperforms traditional LogNormalize for correcting sequencing depth differences. Regress out mitochondrial gene proportion.

steps.name: 降维
steps.notes: 先用 JackStraw/ElbowPlot 确定 PC 数量。UMAP 是目前主流可视化方法，t-SNE 可作为补充。
steps.notesEn: Use JackStraw/ElbowPlot to determine PC count. UMAP is the mainstream visualization; t-SNE can supplement.

steps.name: 聚类
steps.notes: resolution 参数需根据预期细胞类型数调整（0.4-1.2）。每个 cluster 的 marker gene 用 FindAllMarkers 鉴定。
steps.notesEn: Resolution parameter should be adjusted by expected cell type count (0.4-1.2). Identify cluster marker genes with FindAllMarkers.

steps.name: 细胞类型注释
steps.notes: 先用 SingleR 或 CellTypist 自动注释，再用已知 marker gene 手动校正。参考数据集推荐 Human Primary Cell Atlas 或 Blueprint/ENCODE。
steps.notesEn: First use SingleR or CellTypist for automatic annotation, then manually correct with known marker genes. Recommended reference: Human Primary Cell Atlas or Blueprint/ENCODE.

steps.name: 高级分析
steps.description: 拟时序 / 细胞通讯 / 调控网络
steps.notes: 根据研究目的选择：轨迹推断（Monocle3/Slingshot）、配体-受体（CellChat/NicheNet）、转录因子（SCENIC/pySCENIC）。
steps.notesEn: Choose based on research goal: trajectory (Monocle3/Slingshot), ligand-receptor (CellChat/NicheNet), transcription factor (SCENIC/pySCENIC).

references.title: Current best practices in scRNA-seq (Luecken & Theis, 2019)

overviewEn: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis pipeline. From raw FASTQ or count matrices through QC, normalization, dimensionality reduction, clustering, marker gene identification, and cell type annotation. Suitable for 10x Genomics and other droplet-based platforms.
